summary: 本轮按增量去重规则复查了 arXiv、公开项目页、实验室与公司研究页面、GitHub 及相关研究信息后，没有发现 2026-08-05 之后首次公开、且将灵巧机器人手或灵巧操作作为核心贡献的新增条目。当前窗口里可见的近邻结果要么早于本次时间窗，要么相关性不足，因此本次不新增项目。
summary_en: After an incremental de-duplication pass over arXiv, public project pages, lab and company research pages, GitHub, and related research sources, I did not find any newly published item after 2026-08-05 that made dexterous robot hands or dexterous manipulation a central contribution. The nearby results visible in this window were either earlier than the cutoff or not relevant enough, so no items are added.
caveats: 本轮沿用已有 seen-items 状态做增量去重，且未启用 refresh_today 重建。
检索窗口重点放在 2026-08-05 之后的公开信息；之前已公开但本轮仍可见的近邻候选不作为新增条目。
